emphasis.$description: Strong accent background for active states and focused states

org.primer.llm.rules: MUST use for selected or active states. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle accent background for informational or selected elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for selected states or informational highlights. Pair with fgColor.accent for text.

emphasis.$description: Strong attention background for prominent warnings

muted.$description: Subtle attention background for warnings and caution states

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for warnings that need user attention. Pair with fgColor.attention for text.
Avoid using raw black. Use semantic alternatives: bgColor.emphasis for dark backgrounds, bgColor.inverse for inverted contexts. Raw black/white ignore theme preferences and accessibility settings.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for closed state badges and labels

muted.$description: Subtle background for closed state indicators (issues, PRs)

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for closed/declined status indicators. Specifically for GitHub issues and PRs.

emphasis.$description: Emphasized danger background for critical errors and delete confirmations

org.primer.llm.rules: MUST use for destructive action buttons like delete. Use fgColor.onEmphasis for text on this background.

muted.$description: Muted danger background for error states and destructive action contexts

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for error states and destructive action backgrounds. Pair with fgColor.danger for text.

default.$description: Default background color for pages and main content areas

org.primer.llm.rules: Use as the primary background for pages and content areas. Do NOT use for emphasis or highlighting.
MUST use for disabled state backgrounds. Pair with fgColor.disabled for text. Do NOT use for active elements.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for completed/done state badges and labels

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for prominent done/completed state indicators. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle background for completed/done state indicators

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for completed/done status indicators. Conveys finished or merged state.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for draft state badges and labels

muted.$description: Subtle background for draft state indicators

emphasis.$description: High-emphasis dark background for strong visual contrast

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for elements needing strong visual emphasis. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text. Do NOT use for large areas.

inset.$description: Inset background for recessed content areas like wells or sunken panels

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for visually recessed areas. Creates depth hierarchy. Suitable for input fields and wells.

inverse.$description: Inverse background that flips between light and dark modes

org.primer.llm.rules: Use when you need opposite theme background. Pair with fgColor.onInverse for text.

muted.$description: Muted background for secondary content areas and subtle grouping

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for secondary content areas or to create visual grouping. Do NOT use for primary page backgrounds.

emphasis.$description: Strong neutral background for prominent neutral elements

muted.$description: Subtle neutral background for tags, labels, and secondary UI elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for neutral semantic meaning. Pair with fgColor.default for text. Do NOT use for status indicators.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for open state badges and labels

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for prominent open/active state indicators. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle background for open state indicators (issues, PRs)

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for open/active status indicators. Specifically for GitHub issues and PRs.

emphasis.$description: Strong severe background for prominent high-priority warnings

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for prominent severe warnings. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle severe background for high-priority warnings

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for severe warnings, less critical than danger. Pair with fgColor.severe for text.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for prominent GitHub Sponsors elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for prominent Sponsors CTAs. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle background for GitHub Sponsors content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for GitHub Sponsors related content. Do NOT use for general pink-colored elements.

emphasis.$description: Strong success background for prominent positive actions

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for positive action buttons like merge or confirm. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle success background for positive feedback and completed states

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for success states and positive feedback. Pair with fgColor.success for text.

emphasis.$description: Strong background for prominent upsell elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for prominent upgrade/upsell CTAs. Pair with fgColor.onEmphasis for text.

muted.$description: Subtle background for upsell and promotional content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for upgrade prompts and premium feature highlights. Do NOT use for regular content.

Avoid using raw white. Use semantic alternatives: bgColor.default for standard backgrounds, bgColor.inset for recessed areas, or bgColor.inverse for inverted contexts. Raw black/white ignore theme preferences and accessibility settings.

emphasis.$description: Strong accent border for selected or focused elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for selected elements and focus states. Strong visual emphasis.

muted.$description: Subtle accent border for selected or focused elements

emphasis.$description: Strong attention border for prominent warnings

muted.$description: Subtle attention border for warnings and caution states

emphasis.$description: Strong border for closed state badges

muted.$description: Subtle border for closed state indicators

emphasis.$description: Strong danger border for destructive actions and errors

muted.$description: Subtle danger border for errors and destructive contexts

disabled.$description: Border color for disabled interactive elements

emphasis.$description: Strong border for completed/done state badges

muted.$description: Subtle border for completed/done state indicators

emphasis.$description: Strong border for draft state badges

muted.$description: Subtle border for draft state indicators

emphasis.$description: Strong border for emphasis and visual weight

muted.$description: Subtle border for secondary elements and light separators

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for subtle borders and separators. Less prominent than borderColor.default.

emphasis.$description: Strong neutral semantic border

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for emphasized neutral semantic borders. Stronger than neutral.muted.

muted.$description: Subtle neutral semantic border

emphasis.$description: Strong border for open state badges

muted.$description: Subtle border for open state indicators

emphasis.$description: Strong severe border for prominent high-priority warnings

muted.$description: Subtle severe border for high-priority warnings

emphasis.$description: Strong border for prominent GitHub Sponsors elements

muted.$description: Subtle border for GitHub Sponsors content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for GitHub Sponsors related borders. Do NOT use for general pink-colored elements.

emphasis.$description: Strong success border for prominent positive elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for emphasized success borders. Pair with bgColor.success.emphasis.

muted.$description: Subtle success border for positive feedback elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for success state borders. Pair with bgColor.success.muted.

translucent.$description: Semi-transparent border for overlays and layered elements. Border-specific token — no bgColor-translucent counterpart exists by design.

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for semi-transparent borders on overlays. Works well with translucent backgrounds.

emphasis.$description: Strong border for prominent upsell elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for emphasized upsell borders. Pair with bgColor.upsell.emphasis.

muted.$description: Subtle border for upsell and promotional content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for upgrade prompts and premium feature borders. Do NOT use for regular content.

accent.$description: Accent text for links and interactive elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for accent-colored text and icons. Pair with bgColor.accent.muted for backgrounds.

attention.$description: Attention text for warnings and caution states

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for warning and caution text. Pair with bgColor.attention.muted for backgrounds.
Avoid using raw black. Use semantic alternatives: fgColor.default for standard text, fgColor.muted for secondary text. Raw black/white ignore theme preferences and accessibility settings.

closed.$description: Text color for closed state indicators (issues, PRs)

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for closed/declined status text. Specifically for GitHub issues and PRs.

danger.$description: Danger text for errors and destructive actions

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for error messages and destructive action text. Pair with bgColor.danger.muted for backgrounds.

default.$description: Default text color for primary content and headings

org.primer.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default for all text. Use for headings, body text, and primary labels.

disabled.$description: Text color for disabled interactive elements

org.primer.llm.rules: MUST use for disabled state text. Pair with bgColor.disabled. Do NOT use for active elements.

done.$description: Text color for completed/done state indicators

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for completed/done status text. Conveys finished or merged state.

draft.$description: Text color for draft state indicators

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for draft/WIP status text. Conveys incomplete or pending state.
MUST use for all text links. Provides expected link affordance.

muted.$description: Muted text for secondary content and less important information

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for secondary text like timestamps, metadata, and helper text. Do NOT use for primary content.

neutral.$description: Neutral semantic text for icons and secondary elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for neutral semantic elements. Prefer fgColor.muted for secondary text.

onEmphasis.$description: Text color for use on emphasis backgrounds

org.primer.llm.rules: MUST use for text on any emphasis background (bgColor.*.emphasis). Ensures accessibility contrast.

onInverse.$description: Text color for use on inverse backgrounds

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for text on bgColor.inverse. Provides appropriate contrast in both themes.

open.$description: Text color for open state indicators (issues, PRs)

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for open/active status text. Specifically for GitHub issues and PRs.
Use for severe warnings, less critical than danger. Pair with bgColor.severe.muted for backgrounds.

sponsors.$description: Text color for GitHub Sponsors content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for GitHub Sponsors related text. Do NOT use for general pink-colored text.

success.$description: Success text for positive feedback and completed states

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for success states and positive feedback text. Pair with bgColor.success.muted for backgrounds.

upsell.$description: Text color for upsell and promotional content

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for upgrade prompts and premium feature text. Do NOT use for regular content.

Avoid using raw white. Use semantic alternatives: fgColor.onEmphasis for text on dark backgrounds, fgColor.onInverse for inverted contexts. Raw black/white ignore theme preferences and accessibility settings.

outline.$description: Focus ring outline for keyboard navigation and accessibility.

org.primer.llm.rules: Always ensure focus states are visible. Do not override with custom focus styles that reduce visibility. Use for interactive elements like buttons, links, and form controls.

outline-color.$description: Outline color for focus states on interactive elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for focus outlines on interactive elements like buttons, links, and form controls. MUST be visible for keyboard navigation accessibility. Do NOT use for decorative borders or non-interactive elements.

bgColor.$description: Background color for text selection highlights

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for native text selection (::selection) and programmatic text highlighting. Do NOT use for general emphasis or background colors on containers.

large.$description: Large floating shadow for modals and dialogs

org.primer.llm.rules: MUST use for modals and dialogs. Do NOT use for small floating elements.

medium.$description: Medium floating shadow for popovers and action menus

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for medium-sized floating elements like popovers and action menus. More prominent than small but less than dialogs. Do NOT use for full modals.

small.$description: Small floating shadow for dropdowns, tooltips, and small overlays

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for small floating elements like dropdowns and tooltips. Do NOT use for modals or dialogs.

xlarge.$description: Extra large floating shadow for full-screen overlays and sheets

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for full-screen or near-full-screen overlays like side sheets and drawers. Maximum elevation in the system. Do NOT use for small floating elements.
Use for elements that appear pressed or inset into the surface. Commonly used for input fields and wells. Do NOT use for floating elements.

medium.$description: Medium resting shadow for cards and elevated surfaces

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for cards and content panels that sit above the page surface. Provides moderate elevation without appearing to float. Do NOT use for overlays or modals.

small.$description: Small resting shadow for buttons and interactive elements

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for buttons and small interactive elements at rest. Provides subtle depth and clickable affordance. RECOMMENDED for default button shadows.

xsmall.$description: Extra small resting shadow for minimal elevation

org.primer.llm.rules: Use for very subtle elevation on small elements. Provides minimal lift from surface. Do NOT use for interactive elements needing clear affordance.
